overview_description.description: Legal Advice Middle East is a Dubai-based LegalTech platform founded in 2015 that helps users access legal advice, lawyer directories, legal consultations, and legal resources online across the Middle East region. The platform allows consumers to ask legal questions, connect with licensed lawyers, request consultations, and access services such as legal document drafting, business formation support, and legal research. It also provides multilingual support, remote legal assistance, and a knowledge base featuring legal articles, laws, and FAQs tailored to regional legal systems.

about_short_description.short_description: Legal Advice Middle East is an AI-powered legal services marketplace connecting consumers and lawyers online.

product.name: Ask a Lawyer
product.description: A free, anonymous online service allowing users to submit legal questions and receive answers from qualified lawyers, typically within 48 hours.

product.name: Hire a Lawyer Online
product.description: A service enabling clients to hire lawyers for fixed-fee legal services, with online payment and transparent pricing.

product.name: Lawyer and Law Firm Directory
product.description: An online searchable directory of licensed lawyers and law firms in the UAE and Middle East, filterable by location, practice area, and language.

product.name: Legal Information Resources
product.description: A collection of legal articles, Q&A, laws, regulations, and a legal dictionary providing accessible legal information for the Middle East region.

product.name: Fixed-Fee Legal Services Marketplace
product.description: An online platform offering a variety of fixed-price legal services across multiple practice areas, purchasable directly from lawyers.
